main_text.p: IIS qui intra arcticum Circulum & polum mundi habitant, id est, quorum elevatio maior est 66 grad. 31 scrup. Minor 90 gradib: Horizon ab Ecliptica certas pro ratione exaltationis poli portiones abscindit, utrinq; à solstitiali puncto pari numero graduum distantes, quarum borealis cœlo revoluto nunquam mergitur, australina num-quam producitur. Quare Sole illam perambulate, diem continuum, hanc peruagante noctem continuam habent. Reliqua signa in hemicyclio ascendente praepostere oriuntur recto ordine occidunt: opposita in descendente hemicyclio serie & successione

page.notes: Diagrams: left sphere labelled A, Z, H, D, F, B, G, C; right sphere labelled A, K, H, C, D, G, F, B. Text of the printed lines as set: "IIS qui intra arcticum Circulum & polum mundi habitant, id est, quorum eleuatio maior est 66 grad. 31 scrup. Minor 90 gradib: Horizon ab Ecliptica certas pro ratione exaltationis poli portiones abscindit, utrinq; à solstitiali puncto pari numero graduum distantes, quarum borealis cœlo reuoluto nunquam mergitur, austrina nun-quam producitur." The printed text reads "nunquam" at the line end and "quam producitur" at the start of the following block; the words "austrina nun-" and "quam" are split across the diagram. Transcription of the second half of the sentence "succeßione" reads "ceßione" in the scan, set as printed. Some letters in the lower paragraph are uncertain and may be misread.
